The '''Salzulm banking clan''' was a banking clan active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. One of the clan's vaults was robbed, and an investigation exposed one of the clan's own members as the culprit.<ref name="Economy">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Economic Recovery}}</ref>
